import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int MAX_STATE = (1 << 20) + 5;

    static int n, fullMask, result;
    static int[] firstDP = new int[MAX_STATE];
    static int[] secondDP = new int[MAX_STATE];
    static int[][] constraint = new int[10][10];
    static int[][] matrix = new int[10][10];
    static int[][][] tripleBit = new int[10][10][10];

    static long modPow(long base, long exp) {
        long res = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = (res * base) % MOD;
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static long modInverse(long x) {
        return modPow(x, MOD - 2);
    }

    static boolean checkTriple(int a, int b, int c) {
        int[] vals = {a, b, c};
        int[] order = {0, 1, 2};
        do {
            if (constraint[vals[order[0]]][1] == 1 && 
                constraint[vals[order[1]]][2] == 1 && 
                constraint[vals[order[2]]][3] == 1) {
                return true;
            }
        } while (nextPermutation(order));
        return false;
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(int[] array) {
        int i = array.length - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && array[i] >= array[i + 1]) {
            i--;
        }
        if (i < 0) {
            return false;
        }
        int j = array.length - 1;
        while (array[j] <= array[i]) {
            j--;
        }
        int temp = array[i];
        array[i] = array[j];
        array[j] = temp;
        reverse(array, i + 1, array.length - 1);
        return true;
    }

    static void reverse(int[] array, int start, int end) {
        while (start < end) {
            int temp = array[start];
            array[start] = array[end];
            array[end] = temp;
            start++;
            end--;
        }
    }

    static void firstPass(int coef, int r, int c) {
        if (r == 7 && c == 1) {
            int state = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; ++i)
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; ++j)
                    for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; ++k)
                        if (checkTriple(i, j, k)) {
                            int x = 1;
                            while (x == i || x == j || x == k) ++x;
                            int y = x + 1;
                            while (y == i || y == j || y == k) ++y;
                            int z = y + 1;
                            while (z == i || z == j || z == k) ++z;
                            state |= tripleBit[x][y][z];
                        }
            firstDP[state] = (firstDP[state] + coef) % MOD;
            return;
        }
        
        constraint[r][c] = 1;
        if (c == 3) firstPass((int)((long)coef * matrix[r][c] % MOD), r + 1, 1);
        else firstPass((int)((long)coef * matrix[r][c] % MOD), r, c + 1);
        constraint[r][c] = 0;
        
        if (c == 3) firstPass((int)((long)coef * (MOD + 1 - matrix[r][c]) % MOD), r + 1, 1);
        else firstPass((int)((long)coef * (MOD + 1 - matrix[r][c]) % MOD), r, c + 1);
    }

    static void secondPass(int coef, int r, int c) {
        if (r == 7 && c == 4) {
            int state = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 6; ++i)
                for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; ++j)
                    for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; ++k)
                        if (checkTriple(i, j, k)) state |= tripleBit[i][j][k];
            secondDP[state] = (secondDP[state] + coef) % MOD;
            result = (result + (int)((long)firstDP[fullMask ^ state] * coef % MOD)) % MOD;
            return;
        }
        
        constraint[r][c - 3] = 1;
        if (c == 6) secondPass((int)((long)coef * matrix[r][c] % MOD), r + 1, 4);
        else secondPass((int)((long)coef * matrix[r][c] % MOD), r, c + 1);
        constraint[r][c - 3] = 0;
        
        if (c == 6) secondPass((int)((long)coef * (MOD + 1 - matrix[r][c]) % MOD), r + 1, 4);
        else secondPass((int)((long)coef * (MOD + 1 - matrix[r][c]) % MOD), r, c + 1);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                int temp = sc.nextInt();
                matrix[i][j] = (int)((long)temp * modInverse(100) % MOD);
            }
        for (int i = n + 1; i <= 6; ++i) matrix[i][i] = 1;
        
        int bitIdx = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 6; ++i)
            for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; ++j)
                for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; ++k)
                    tripleBit[i][j][k] = 1 << bitIdx++;
        
        firstPass(1, 1, 1);
        fullMask = (1 << 20) - 1;
        
        for (int b = 0; b < 20; ++b)
            for (int s = 0; s <= fullMask; ++s)
                if ((s >> b & 1) == 1)
                    firstDP[s] = (firstDP[s] + firstDP[s ^ (1 << b)]) % MOD;
        
        secondPass(1, 1, 4);
        result = (MOD + 1 - result) % MOD;
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
